## 🚀 Feature Request

## 🔍 Problem Statement

Is your feature request related to a problem? Describe it clearly.
_Example: "I'm always frustrated when trying to do X because…"_

## 💡 Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you'd like to see added or changed.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've already considered and why they fall short.

## 📖 Example Usage

If applicable, show how you imagine using this feature in Salam code:

```salam
func main {
    // Example of the proposed feature
}
```

## 🌍 Who Benefits

Explain who would benefit from this feature and why it would be valuable to the broader community.

## 🔗 Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, links to related issues, or prior art from other languages here.

---

> 💡 Before submitting, please search [existing issues](https://github.com/SalamLang/Salam/issues) to avoid duplicates.
> Join us on [Discord](https://discord.gg/HfY3QHDPdv) or [Telegram](https://t.me/SalamProgrammingLanguage) to discuss the idea with the community first!
